name: BizBot
tagline: A roaming robot event photographer that finds hot spots and only releases photos that pass an AI quality check.
problem: Event photos are either missing or hundreds of low-quality shots.
solution: A robot controlled from a web app detects activity hot spots, takes candid shots, and gates releases through a configurable quality model, with a gallery and admin dashboard.
demo_moment: Team-described: the robot roams the room and only good photos appear in the gallery.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[Block] Best Real-World Ready AI Product” among 169 submissions.
Designed for messy real environments, matching the 'real-world ready' prize.

lessons: A robot working the judging floor is its own demo.
